newsitem.title: IRAN: Pipe-laying work completed on Turkmen gas line-Iran.
newsitem.headline: Pipe-laying work completed on Turkmen gas line-Iran.

text.p: Iran has completed laying pipes in Turkmenistan for a pipeline to supply Turkmen gas to Iranian power plants, a newspaper said on Thursday.

The daily Kayhan quoted an Iranian oil official in Turkmenistan as saying the National Iranian Oil Industry and Engineering Company had completed laying pipes for a 140 km (88 mile) section of the 200 km pipeline to Iran's border.
The company was ahead of schedule in its work on the line which would extend another 60 km on Iranian territory, the unnamed official added.
Tehran has said the pipeline, which will connect the Turkmen Korpedzhe gas field to Kord-Kuy in northern Iran, will be completed this year.
The pipeline, the first new export line from the former Soviet Union not to pass through Russia, is expected to supply Iran with two billion cubic metres of Turkmen gas in its first year.
The $190 million pipeline deal is to be paid 80 percent by Turkmenistan through gas sales to Iran and 20 percent in cash, Iranian officials have said.
The line is eventually planned to supply eight billion cubic metres a year in 10 years time.
